messages.text: Booking the Japan trip through Studio Northstar — Tokyo then Kyoto, 11 to 22 April. The package is about EUR 3,150 all in (flights, hotels, rail pass, two tours).
Yes! Finally. That price is totally fine for nine nights. Book it.
Done. So excited — omakase and teamLab are on the list.
The omakase tonight at Sushi Aoyama was worth every yen.
Best meal of my life. And teamLab yesterday was amazing too.
Tokyo is delivering. Kyoto next week.
Just tallied it — the whole Japan trip came to about EUR 3,700 once you add the food and shopping on top of the package.
So worth it. Already want to go back.
